author: Microsoft
description:
Microsoft’s latest AI Diffusion Report reveals how the world is adopting AI globally, and what that means for countries embracing this new general-purpose technology. In this special edition of Tools and Weapons, Microsoft's Vice Chair and President Brad Smith sits down with Juan Lavista Ferres, Chief Data Scientist and Director of the AI for Good Lab, to unpack the report’s most striking insights.

Together, they explore why diffusion (not just invention) will determine who benefits most from AI, spotlight countries leading the charge like the UAE, Singapore, and South Korea, and examine the rise of models such as China’s DeepSeek across parts of Africa. It’s a conversation about technology’s reach, the pace of progress, and what it means for the world.
